executive_summary: Is lecture mein humne HTML5 multimedia elements detail mein seekhe. Humne dekha ki <video> aur <audio> tags kaise kaam karte hain, controls, autoplay, muted, loop aur poster attributes kaise use hote hain, aur YouTube videos ko <iframe> ke through seamlessly kaise embed kiya jata hai.
learning_objectives: <video> aur <audio> tags ke native capabilities master karna
Media attributes (controls, autoplay, muted, loop, poster) ka behavior samajhna
Multiple browser compatibility ke liye <source> tags configure karna
<iframe> tag use karke YouTube aur maps embed karna

sections.heading: 1. <video> Tag & Essential Attributes
sections.content: <video> tag bina kisi external player ke video stream karta hai. Agar aap controls attribute nahi denge toh user ko play/pause buttons nahi dikhenge. Modern browsers mein video tabhi autoplay hoti hai jab usme muted attribute laga ho.
code_snippets:
<video src="media/sample.mp4" controls width="640" poster="thumbnail.jpg">
  Your browser does not support the video tag.
</video>

sections.heading: 2. <audio> Element & Fallback Sources
sections.content: <audio> tag sound files play karne ke liye hota hai. Browser compatibility ensure karne ke liye <source src='...' type='audio/mpeg'> use karna standard practice hai.
code_snippets:
<audio controls autoplay muted>
  <source src="podcast.mp3" type="audio/mpeg">
  <source src="podcast.ogg" type="audio/ogg">
</audio>

sections.heading: 3. <iframe> Embeds (YouTube, Maps)
sections.content: <iframe> tag se kisi doosri website ka page ya YouTube video display kiya ja sakta hai. Isme src, width, height, aur allowfullscreen attributes standard hote hain.

definitions_and_terms.definition: HTML5 media tag to play native video files.
Attribute jo video play hone se pehle thumbnail image show karta hai.
Inline frame element for embedding external documents and videos.

common_pitfalls: Autoplay bina muted lagana, jise browser audio policy block kar deti hai.
Controls attribute miss karna jisse student video control nahi kar pata.
Image/video ka invalid relative path dena.
revision_checklist: Kya video tag mein controls attribute added hai?
Autoplay ke saath muted mandatory lagaya hai?
Video thumbnail ke liye poster attribute set hai?
YouTube embed <iframe> mein allowfullscreen enable hai?
